primary.scope: measured warm same512-lane collection; excludes startup/compile/checkpointIO; scenario pricing not billing

primary.scope: measured warm same512-lane collection; excludes startup/compile/checkpointIO; scenario pricing not billing

conservative.scope: measured warm same512-lane collection; excludes startup/compile/checkpointIO; scenario pricing not billing

executable_memory_analysis.scope: compiler device buffer estimate; not host RSS or measured VRAM peak

physical_gpu.scope: selected physical GPU snapshot immediately before prospective compilation

memory_preflight.limitation: scaled actual compiler temporary buffers plus full collection overlap; estimate is not a measured peak or OOM guarantee

host_memory_preflight.limitation: old whole-benchmark RSS scaled by batch lanes plus8GiB; planning screen, not measured stage RSS or reservation

post_measurement_GPU_memory.scope: selected physical GPU snapshot immediately before prospective compilation

provenance.RSS_peak_scope: process cumulative peak through this stage; before/after are actual stage boundary snapshots
provenance.VRAM_scope: actual selected-card preflight/post-measurement snapshots; not a measured peak

server_resources.thread_count_claim: inherited auxiliary mask preserved; allocated CPU count is not a physical-core equivalence claim

thread_affinity_after_backend.scope: post-backend/compile census; cgroup and process affinity remain enclosing allocation bounds

physical_gpu.source: launcher-selected GPU; original numerical manifest lacks physical UUID/driver

environment.warm_reset_policy: each repeat uses the same frozen Day1 end state; two sequential seven-day blocks

checkpoint_io.scope: host snapshot pickle serialization and atomic write/fsync/replace; excludes manifest/report/event writes
